## Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] New skill has `SKILL.md`, `USER_STORY.md` and a row in the README
- [ ] No real names, emails, IPs, hostnames, tokens or private file paths
- [ ] Nothing taken from an employer, client or supplier (names, figures, contracts, internal procedures, code)
- [ ] Anything that can change devices, files or accounts asks for approval first
- [ ] Passes the textbook test: explainable from public standards or common practice, with nothing copied from a company's internal policies or procedures
